title: Ask Ustaad: your personal tutor, now with photo questions
changes: The AI tutor is now Ask Ustaad. Chat like ChatGPT: ask follow-ups like "why?", "explain step 3 again" or "give me a harder one", and Ustaad remembers the conversation.

Snap a question: take a photo or pick one from your gallery (book, guess paper or school test). Ustaad reads it and answers like a perfect exam answer: numbered steps, each with a "Why?", the final answer, the idea behind the topic, an exam tip and a quick check.
If it's a question from your textbook, Ustaad teaches from the app's checked solution, shows the book's figure and answer, and links to the full solution.
Watch a lesson: every answer offers YouTube lessons on that topic.
Ustaad knows you: your weak and strong topics, your exam date and your target marks shape every answer. Choose English, Urdu, or English with Urdu explanations in Profile → My Ustaad.
Your chats are saved on your phone. Open them again from "Chats", or start a new one.
Ask Ustaad stays locked while you're sitting a timed paper.
yourRequests: "AI chat bot name is Ask Ustaad" → renamed everywhere.
"Upload image of questions, answer in real answer steps with explanation" → photo questions with step-by-step answer cards.
"ChatGPT style discussion with complete topic understanding" → real conversation, topic explanations, follow-up suggestions.
"Find relative videos from YouTube" → lesson videos with every answer.
"Student avatar that answers according to that student" → My Ustaad: Ustaad adapts to your level, mistakes, language and goals.

title: Real book diagrams, proper maths, reminders and your progress
changes: Every diagram from your textbook is now in the app: triangles, Venn diagrams, graphs, number lines and constructions (303 figures). 181 questions show their figure, and 75 show the book's answer figure under "Book answer".
Maths looks like your book: stacked fractions, square roots with a bar, and powers written small and raised (x², 10⁻³).
Daily reminder from Ustad at the time you choose (Profile → Daily reminder; 6 pm unless you change it). It only comes on days you haven't studied yet.
Exam countdown on Home: about how many days until your 2027 board exam.
Tap your streak or XP on Home to see your progress: this week's XP chart, your level and your badges.
Under each solution: "Similar questions" from the same exercise, and "Was this helpful?" so we can keep improving answers.
Phones with less memory get a lighter look for the bottom bar, so the app stays smooth.
yourRequests: "What do you think is missing" → round 1 of the plan: diagrams, maths layout, reminders, countdown, progress and badges, similar questions, feedback, speed on low-end phones.

title: Board-style marking, real exam timing and no dead buttons
changes: Board papers now run like the exam hall: the MCQ part has its own 20 minutes and is collected when time ends (or when you hand it in), then the subjective part opens.
Your marked paper shows your grade (A+, A, B, C, D, E or F; pass at 33%) and the examiner's remarks: exactly where you lost marks and how to get them next time.
Every marking point still shows a tick or a cross with what was missing, why it matters and how to earn it.
Mistakes from guided sessions now also count towards your weak topics, so the plan repairs them.
Home's "My book" and "Papers" shortcuts now switch tabs properly (before, they could leave the Book tab unresponsive).
Mock papers that can't be built yet are shown as information instead of cards that look tappable but do nothing.
A new automatic check taps every button on every main screen and fails the build if any of them does nothing.
yourRequests: "Real board like marking assessment" → two-part board timing, grade band and examiner's remarks.
"App is not interactive / should be responsive" → dead buttons found and fixed; a test now guards every button.

title: Learn like a game: guided sessions, streaks and your tutor Ustad
changes: Meet Ustad, your personal tutor. He greets you, tells you what to practise today and cheers you on.
Start today's session from Home: one question at a time, a big Check button, and an instant green or red answer with the reason.
Six kinds of practice: multiple choice, true or false, type your answer, put the solution steps in order, pick the next step, and definition flashcards.
Questions you miss come back at the end of the session until you get them right, and they also feed your weak topics.
XP, a daily goal, a day streak (with a streak freeze every 7 days), levels and badges. Haptics and sounds on every answer (sound can be muted).
Your path: each section of the current unit is a step that fills up as you master it. Tap "All units" to see the whole book.
Busy day? A 5-minute session keeps your streak alive.
Celebration screen with confetti, your XP, accuracy and best combo.
yourRequests: "Duolingo like experience and guided study" → Today's session, the path, XP, streaks and goals.
"Personal tutor feel" → Ustad on Home and in every session, plus "Ask Ustad" on every answer.
"App is not interactive" → every answer gets instant feedback, animations, haptics and sound.

title: Full Class 9 Maths course, exam kits and board papers
changes: Step-by-step solutions for every example and exercise question in all 13 units (1,206 questions). Find any question from Home → Solutions, by unit and exercise or by searching "2.3 Q4".
Every answer is checked against the textbook's answer key. Where the key itself is wrong, you see the right working and a note. A "Book answer" line shows the key's answer.
Every step has a "Why?" that explains the rule behind it, like a tutor sitting next to you.

Exam kit for each unit: definitions to learn word for word, formula sheet, most important questions, likely short questions, how to write for full marks and mistakes that lose marks. Open it from Book → a unit → Exam kit.
Annual Exam 2027 smart syllabus: content the board leaves out is marked "Not in this year's exam · practice", and your plan, tests and papers skip it. Unit 8 (Logic) is not examined in 2027.
Three full board papers (75 marks, 2 h 30 min) laid out exactly like the 2027 paper: 15 MCQs, Q2–Q4 (6 of 9 each), Q5–Q7 (2 of 3), Q8–Q9 (1 of 2).
Unit tests for every unit, including graphs (Unit 5, 10) and constructions (Unit 11): draw on paper and photograph your work.
The app now updates itself: it checks for new builds on every launch and every 6 hours, downloads them in the background and tells you when an update is ready to install with one tap.
This "What's new" page opens after every update, and is always in Profile → What's new.
yourRequests: "Chegg line solution is not working" → Solutions finder and step-by-step answers for every question.
"Find keys for this book and align answer with each problem" → every answer aligned with the textbook key and an independent check.
"Every single thing from book to be covered" → completeness audit: every example and question in the book is in the app.
"Teach them to ace 100/100" → exam kits and board papers on the official 2027 pattern.
"Make this app auto update at its own" → background update checks and downloads.
"Show in app what changes this build includes" → this page.
